name: The Red Cathedral

categories.label: Prestige Points on the track after final rounding down
categories.labelVi: Điểm Prestige trên track (sau khi lùi về ô Prestige gần nhất)
categories.hint: Move your counter back to the closest lower Prestige space (if not already on one); +40 side if past 40. Include the +3 for completing your 6th section.

categories.label: Materials + Rubles returned to supply
categories.labelVi: Vật liệu + Rúp trả về kho

categories.label: Total points from tower majorities (6 towers)
categories.labelVi: Tổng điểm đa số của 6 tháp
categories.hint: Tower value = 2 per completed section + 1 per ornamentation. Rank by banners+ornamentations on completed cards: 1st full value, 2nd half (round down), 3rd half of that... Ties split the pooled points. 2 players: leader all, other one third (round down); tied = 0 each.

categories.label: Completed Cathedral sections
categories.labelVi: Số phần Nhà thờ đã hoàn thành

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

endCondition.description: Game ends when a player completes their sixth Cathedral section (+3 prestige); others get one final turn

notes: family: area-majority. Official rulebook PDF (BGG file by Devir Iberia) could not be downloaded; rules were cross-checked on Dized and Yucata rule summaries, so numbers are medium confidence. Tower points are entered as one total because each tower value depends on its completed sections/ornaments (floor halving per rank, e.g. 7 -> 3 -> 1). Recognition-points track and solo mode not modelled.
